roles.background: zeta functions, explicit formulae, zero-free regions, PNT error terms
roles.finding: The exact source-order transform should use A(x)=floor(x)-psi(x); Bellotti's KV-scale PNT error is unconditional and has exponent 3/5 in log x.
roles.objection: Do not use a zero-density statement as pointwise RH control; use it only through the stated unconditional PNT consequence.
roles.recommendation: Accept SEARCH/Abel routing subject to exact boundary and quantifier checks.

roles.background: Laguerre polynomials, coefficient estimates, uniform asymptotics
roles.finding: Coefficient formulas give elementary envelopes of exp(2 sqrt(nu)) scale for L_{n-1}^1(u) and n^2 exp(2 sqrt(nu)) for the derivative companion.
roles.objection: The envelope is intentionally crude and forces an enormous cutoff; it is not a sharp Laguerre asymptotic.
roles.recommendation: Use it only as a rigorous discriminator; do not claim optimal cutoff.

roles.background: counterexample-first mathematical testing and quantifier stress tests
roles.finding: A sqrt(log x)-scale PNT decay cannot dominate exp(2 sqrt(n log x)) uniformly in n under this operator family.
roles.objection: This refutes the classical-log-plus-crude-envelope route, not every possible use of the 2026 explicit zero-free region.
roles.recommendation: Run the exponent comparator before any detailed constant chase; handle n=1 separately.

roles.background: formal mathematics, quantifier order, dependency and verifier audits
roles.finding: The candidate must state existence of constants and a moving cutoff law before using the tail identity; boundary vanishing and the derivative identity are separate obligations.
roles.objection: No proof assistant or isolated checker is presently bound, so even a paper proof remains shadow mathematical evidence.
roles.recommendation: Record exact lemma statement and dependency ledger; no PROOF_CHECKED event.

roles.background: analytic-number-theory literature mapping and prior-art normalization
roles.finding: The move is a composition of standard Abel summation, elementary Laguerre bounds, and a current PNT theorem.
roles.objection: No literature novelty can be inferred from this cycle.
roles.recommendation: If it survives, classify as compositional/transfer/representation, not theorem novelty.

roles.background: proof DAG interfaces and local-to-global theorem assembly
roles.finding: Even a negligible source-order tail leaves the moving finite prefix and archimedean/Li ledger untouched.
roles.objection: A finite-prefix lower bound sufficient for all-n Li positivity may carry essentially all root difficulty.
roles.recommendation: Record tail closure and finite-prefix gluing as distinct statuses; successor should begin with obligation-strength audit.

roles.finding: RAKL_math main is pinned to the exact current RAKL main and PR #200 migrated historical pre-gate traces fail-closed.
roles.objection: R4 suffered current-framework drift and late TaskEpisode materialization; candidate freeze must recheck current RAKL SHA and pin.

disagreements: Special-functions lead considers the cutoff far too crude for practical computation; analytic lead accepts it because the current atom asks only for existence of a uniform source-order tail modulus.
Novelty lead rejects any novelty claim; gluing lead agrees the value is route localization rather than a new RH theorem.
strongest_objection: A successful tail lemma may merely move essentially all RH difficulty into an astronomically long finite prefix; local success must not be confused with progress toward root closure.
unresolved_uncertainty: Whether a sharper Laguerre representation yields a materially smaller cutoff and whether the moving-prefix obligation is strictly weaker than RH remain open.
recommendation: Proceed only with the SEARCH/Abel candidate after the live framework/pin recheck; use classical-log decay as a falsifier and KV PNT decay as the surviving input.
